items.headline: Sources: Clemson QB Christopher Vizzina (elbow) week-to-week
items.description: Clemson quarterback Christopher Vizzina is considered week-to-week after sustaining an elbow injury Saturday, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel. Freshman Tait Reynolds is expected to start for the Tigers against North Carolina on Saturday.

items.headline: Backup QB Tait Reynolds leads 5 scoring drives as Clemson defeats Georgia Southern 22-7
items.description: — Freshman Tait Reynolds replaced an injured Christopher Vizzina at quarterback and threw for 178 yards and led five scoring drives as Clemson defeated Georgia Southern 22-7 on Saturday night following a two-hour lightning delay.

items.headline: Will No. 8 LSU maintain success after tattooing Clemson?
items.description: SEC Network's Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson praise Lane Kiffin for preparing his team and dominating their opener against Clemson.
